title: The agent wallet is capped by the ledger, not by our code
proves: The agent wallet trusts RLUSD only up to a 10 RLUSD limit set on the ledger, so its allowance cannot be raised by a bug or an attacker.
summary: Agent trust line limit is 10 RLUSD, set on the ledger.

assertions.description: the agent has an RLUSD trust line
it holds no more than its limit
an ordinary visitor wallet, by contrast, has a much higher limit
